title: Luscious Flaky Uruguayan Cheese Tagine
description: A delicious, flaky, and cheesy Uruguayan brunch dish made in a clay tajine vessel. Perfect for a weekend morning with family or friends.
instructions: Heat a clay tajine over low heat on a stovetop or in a conventional oven at 375°F (190°C).
Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the preheated tajine and swirl it around to coat the surface.
In a separate bowl, mix together 2 tablespoons of grated Manchego cheese, 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh parsley, and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Add the cheese mixture to the preheated tajine and top with 2 large egg slices, leaving about 1 inch of space around each egg.
Cover the tajine with its lid and cook for 8 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the eggs are cooked to your desired doneness.
Remove the tajine from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
